mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the cost of capital and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE has been below 4.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between the joint growth of HOUST and RSAFS and SPX 20-day returns is less than 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), a rising CPIAUCSL indicates persistent inflation, which leads to higher real interest rates and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has risen > 0.25pp in 3 months and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing output, which typically leads to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 2300 thousand units, it signals strong residential construction activity, which drives consumer confidence and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST has exceeded 2300 for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in both the federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL indicates a dovish monetary policy response to disinflation, which reduces real interest rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between the joint decline of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL and SPX 20-day returns is less than 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery phase (UNRATE falling below 4.8% and PAYEMS rising above 135,000), strong employment growth supports consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE is below 4.8% and PAYEMS exceeds 135,000 for 3 consecutive months.
